name: MGM Resorts International
business: Operates casino resorts in Las Vegas, US regional markets and Macau plus online sports betting and iGaming, serving gaming, leisure, business and convention customers.

events.what: CEO contract extended to 2028-12-31 (no CEO change); Hornbuckle CEO since 2020-07-29

COO Corey Sanders moved to Senior Advisor after his COO term ended 2025-12-31; Ayesha Molino is COO on the Q1 and Q2 2026 calls (her appointment not found as an Item 5.02 filing; background not verified)

New employment agreements (renewals, not new hires): CFO Jonathan Halkyard and CCO/President MGM Digital Gary Fritz effective 2025-10-01; Chief Legal and Administrative Officer John McManus effective 2026-01-01
events.who: Jonathan Halkyard; Gary Fritz; John McManus

events.what: Board: Donna Langley appointed 2025-03-12 (just before the 18-month window); Keith Barr 2024-08-21

next_event.source: No Investor Day or framework update found in the Baba corpus (lexical 'investor day' FY2026 search: no hits). Next scheduled event is the Q3 2026 earnings call (date not found).

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: VA EBITDA is after roughly $25B of lease liabilities' rent (triple-net leases to VICI and others), so MGM's 13% margin versus a 25.6% industry median is largely a lease-accounting artifact, not an operating gap. The only dated numeric figure is a $200M run-rate EBITDA enhancement program (announced 2024, more than $150M 'taking effect this calendar year' 2025, 35% revenue and 65% cost); that horizon has passed and no 2026 or later figure was found. MGM Digital 'capable of $1B run-rate top line with double-digit EBITDA margins' has no year.

statements.quote: Recall, we estimate the collective impact of enhancements that we announced last year will boost EBITDA by a run rate of $200 million, and we're now pacing to capture more than $150 million taking effect this calendar year, 35% of which comes from revenue actions and 65% from cost savings.
statements.speaker: Jonathan Halkyard
statements.doc_title: MGM Resorts International Q1 2025 Earnings Call

statements.quote: To say nothing of the value of MGM Digital, the business we know is capable of a billion dollars in run rate top line with double-digit EBITDA margins.
statements.speaker: Jonathan Halkyard
statements.doc_title: MGM Resorts International Q1 2025 Earnings Call

street.gap_assumption: December year end, Baba labels equal calendar years. No live company-level margin target, so no gap. D scored on the no-level rule: 4-month EBITDA revision -2.98%, 2 bps inside the -3% stabilization line; 12-month revision -12.5%. Consensus already has margin rising about 130 bps FY2026 to FY2028.
street.source: Baba data_financials consensus (fundamentals, Visible Alpha); data_comps revisions asof 2026-10-01

evidence_of_progress.note: Order is [Q1 2026, Q2 2026], VA EBITDA margin (after rent). Q1 hit by $37M Las Vegas and $9M regional headwinds (Halkyard, doc 140410 snippet) and the new MGM China brand fee; CEO says Las Vegas is 'stabilizing and growing' in Q2 (doc 110782 snippet). MGM Digital still loss-making (segment adjusted EBITDA -$26M Q1, -$31M Q2).

verdict: Cheap and down 39%, but no GXO catalyst: CEO extended to 2028, CFO renewed, only an internal COO handover, and the below-peer margin is mostly lease structure.
open_questions: Is there any new cost or margin program for 2026 to 2027 now that the $200M enhancement program has run its course?
When does MGM Digital reach the stated double-digit EBITDA margin, and will management date it?
Does estimate erosion (-12.5% in 12 months, -3.0% in 4 months) stop with Las Vegas stabilizing, or is the 4-month figure about to cross -3%?
